How do I adjust the balance between the fuzz and the original guitar signal on the MXR BLUE BOX FUZZ M103? To adjust the balance between the fuzz effect and the original guitar signal, use the 'BLEND' control. Turning the knob clockwise will increase the amount of sub-octave fuzz, while turning it counterclockwise will decrease it. 0 What should I do if the MXR BLUE BOX FUZZ M103 is not powering on? Ensure that the device is connected to a power source. The MXR BLUE BOX FUZZ M103 can be powered by a 9-volt battery, a 9-volt AC adapter such as the Dunlop ECB003/ECB003E, or a DC Brick power supply. Check the battery status or the connection of the power adapter. 0 How can I increase the overall volume of the effect on the MXR BLUE BOX FUZZ M103? To increase the overall volume of the effect, rotate the 'OUTPUT' knob clockwise. This will boost the effect's volume. 0 My MXR BLUE BOX FUZZ M103 does not toggle between effect on and bypass, what might be wrong? If the pedal does not toggle between effect on and bypass, check the functionality of the footswitch. Ensure that it is not damaged and that the connections are secure. The red LED should indicate when the effect is on. 0 Is the manual of the MXR BLUE BOX FUZZ M103 available in English? Yes, the manual of the MXR BLUE BOX FUZZ M103 is available in English .
